correctness.rationale: The independent Hoppe parent choices give P(parent_i=root)=θ/(θ+i-2). For nonroot j, its no-child survival probability telescopes to (θ+j-2)/(θ+n-2). Summing cross covariances of root-child indicators with no-child indicators yields C_n=θ(n-1)(n-2)/(2(θ+n-2)²) for all θ>0 and n>=2. Direct differentiation has sign n-2-θ, giving unique θ=n-2 maximizer and value (n-1)/8 for n>=3; at n=2 covariance 0 for all θ. The critical θ_n/n→α limit is α/[2(1+α)²], while other regimes come from dominance of the same exact formula. Independent full rational parent-history enumeration n<=8 at θ=1/2,1,3,7/2 corroborates.
residual_risks: Finite histories do not independently prove all n,θ; the telescoping expectation proof does.
